beats.narration: Full time. Agon has written the club's match report in four languages, and nothing is published until the media officer approves this exact bundle in Microsoft Teams.

visual.actions: the approval card arrives in the Match Day channel, unasked

beats.narration: The match is synthetic, from our own seeded league. Home and away are clear at a glance, and Agon's interpret model turns the event log into expected goals, pressure and win probability.

visual.actions: Match Centre at 375 px on the recorded run's match: scoreboard, home and away timeline, then the win probability chart if shipped

beats.narration: At the whistle, Microsoft Foundry agents in a Microsoft Agent Framework workflow pick the turning points and write the report. Code checks every number and name; here the Fact Gate sent a wrong score back to the writer, once.

visual.actions: Newsroom Wall at 1920 on the recorded run, stepping to the Fact Gate line

beats.narration: The card arrives without anyone asking. The officer reads the report they attest, ticks the flagged sentence, leaves Instagram out, and approves.

visual.actions: the officer reads the attested report, ticks the flagged row, unticks Instagram, taps Approve

beats.narration: While the card waited, the worker process ended. The approval woke a new one, which resumed from the durable checkpoint and published exactly once.

visual.actions: the media office operations view if shipped, otherwise the Verify custody trail: the two worker executions, ended and resumed

beats.narration: The same card now says where the report went: the club site, the feeds, Greek, Spanish, French, an easy-read edition and audio, from one approval.

visual.actions: the card updated in place to Published, naming the destinations
Recap edition tabs EN, EL, ES, FR and easy-read, with audio

beats.narration: Anyone can check it. Every file is hashed again in your browser, and the approved hash equals the published hash.

visual.actions: open Verify at 1920 so the recomputation runs on camera, then bring the recorded run's approved and published comparison into view

facts.text: Recomputed in your browser: the bundle hash equals the hash on the approval card

beats.narration: The data is ours: a deterministic season, the same on every machine, with realism bands frozen before calibration.

visual.actions: Data Lab: the season table, then the determinism figures

beats.narration: Take Foundry out and no report exists. Take the checkpoint out and an approval cannot survive a restart. Take Teams out and nothing publishes. Agon: the demo and the code are linked below.

visual.actions: the architecture frame with the load-bearing sentence, the live URL and the repo URL
